crossRefs.note: The sons of Eliezer were: Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth…

people.name: Isshiah
people.line: Levite, descendant of Rehabiah during David's reign.

people.name: Rehabiah
people.line: Son of Eliezer, grandson of Moses, a Levite

translations.web: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
translations.bsb: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: The first was Isshiah.
translations.kjv: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
translations.asv: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
